error.title: Document exceeds the PSD size limits
error.description:
### Document is larger than PSD supports The document is **{width}x{height} px**. PSD stores documents up to **30000 x 30000 px** and **2 GB**; a larger document has to be saved as **PSB**. Photoshop converts automatically, so the workfile and PSD layer extractions end up as PSB.
### How to continue - **Resize** the document below 30000 px per side, or - continue in PSB, or - **Disable** the **Validate Document Size** validator, it is informational only. Raster representations (PNG/JPG/TIFF) may still fail above 2 GB.
The validator can be disabled from the publisher's plugin list or in `ayon+settings://photoshop/publish/ValidateDocumentSize`.
